entries.title: 2026 Taiwan Baseball Data Analysis Competition
entries.subtitle: On-Field Tactical Analysis Group (in preparation)
highlights: Studying the break-even success-rate threshold for stealing in CPBL games with two outs and a runner on first only, in innings 1-8, and how that threshold shifts with batting-order position and batter type

Introduces a "retention effect": a failed steal keeps that batter's at-bat held over to start the next inning, correcting a blind spot in traditional RE24 analysis that only looks at the current half-inning
Data drawn from a custom scraper of the CPBL website covering the 2025 season, with a self-built batter decision simulation model
Written materials due 2026/10/31; teams that advance present live on 12/19
